fixed_defects.errors: TS2304 Cannot find name 'AgentViewSession' x12 (plus 6 TS18048 'miss' possibly undefined and 3 TS7006 cascades that only exist because the name resolved to an error type)
fixed_defects.cause: the 18.18.0 rebase of family-input-translation replaced the `import type { AgentViewSession } from "../session/agent-session-handle"` line while inserting the family's `RestoredQueuedMessage` import (family-input-translation-v18.18.0.patch: `-import type { AgentViewSession } ...`), so the type name no longer resolved
fixed_defects.fix: restored the import in both files (alphabetical position, before agent-session-types)

fixed_defects.errors: TS2304 Cannot find name 'PresentedBlock'/'messageBlock' x14 (plus 5 TS7006 cascades)
fixed_defects.cause: the same rebase hunk dropped `import { messageBlock, PresentedBlock } from "@oh-my-pi/pi-tui/chat/transcript-presentation"`. These are VALUES, not types: every transcript row built by this module would have thrown a ReferenceError at runtime, and no gate renders the TUI transcript

fixed_defects.errors: TS2367 x2 (comparison '"openai-codex-responses"' vs '"anthropic-messages"' has no overlap)
fixed_defects.cause: the 18.18.0 summary plumbing guarded `statefulResponses` with a model.api ternary inside two Codex-only branches, where model.api is already narrowed; the guard is dead code
fixed_defects.fix: removed both dead ternary lines (the option is absent, i.e. undefined, exactly as before; the Anthropic opt-out is asserted by leg 9 of the threads gate)

fixed_defects.errors: TS2353 'statefulResponses' does not exist in type 'AnthropicNativeCompactionOptions'
fixed_defects.cause: a real seam hole: the Anthropic-native compaction lane (0066/0088/0089) was passed the summary thread opt-out, but the native options type did not declare it and `requestAnthropicNativeCompaction` never forwarded it, so an Anthropic native summary would plan a message thread whose settle() replaces the main conversation's thread anchor
fixed_defects.fix: added `statefulResponses` to the options Pick, forwarded it into the instrumentedCompleteSimple options, mirrored it in the published `dist/types` declaration, and added wire leg `summary-native` to verify-anthropic-threads-warm-compaction-isolation (control: the same call threads without the opt-out)
